title: Just Image Transformers with Late-Stage Pixel Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2611.13120v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent work on latent-free diffusion transformers has demonstrated the feasibility of training image generators without a latent VAE. This avoids compression artifacts from the VAE and simplifies the training pipeline. In particular, JiT showed that even a standard transformer can be trained to generate images when the model is trained to predict the final image ($x$-prediction). Even though JiT unlocks training efficiency comparable to latent models, it still suffers from reduced image quality likely arising from modeling the image as a collection of large patches. In this work, we revisit JiT and show that adding simple convolutional pixel-pathway layers in a post-training phase significantly improves generation quality. Moreover, we show that the added pixel-pathway does not need to be active in the early denoising stages, and can be activated as late as in the last $20\%$ of the denoising process. translated_title: 即时图像Transformer与后期像素精炼
translated_abstract: 近期关于无潜空间扩散Transformer的研究表明，无需潜空间VAE来训练图像生成器是可行的。这避免了VAE带来的压缩伪影，并简化了训练流程。特别是JiT（Just Image Transformers）证明，即使是一个标准的Transformer，只要训练其预测最终图像（x-prediction），也能生成图像。尽管JiT实现了与潜空间模型相当的训练效率，但可能由于将图像建模为大型图块的集合，其图像质量仍有所下降。在这项工作中，我们重新审视了JiT，并证明在后训练阶段添加简单的卷积像素通路层可以显著提升生成质量。此外，我们表明所添加的像素通路无需在早期去噪阶段激活，甚至可以推迟到去噪过程的最后20%阶段才激活。我们在ImageNet@256上的实验……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出在JiT（无VAE潜空间的图像Transformer）后训练阶段添加简单的卷积像素通路层，且该通路只需在去噪最后约20%阶段激活，即可显著提升图像生成质量。
